brief.headline: NVDA's 4.9x volume rout offsets AMD's $19.3B inflow; small caps bleed
tldr: NVDA fell 4.3% on 4.9x normal volume, a bottom-4% move.
AMD surged 5.9% on $19.3B inflow, 2.2x volume, 89th percentile.
Small caps (IWM) dropped 1.6% with 0.99x volume, bottom 8%.
10Y yield rose 10.5 bps to 5.10%, TLT fell 1.5% on 1.3x volume.

where_money_moved.evidence: AMD drew $19.3B, 2.2x volume, +5.9%; AVGO added $10.1B, 1.9x volume, +5.5%.
NVDA lost $4.3B on 4.9x volume, -4.3%, bottom 4% of its year.
IWM saw $4.9B outflow, -1.6%, bottom 8% of its year; SMCI -11.3% on 2.4x volume.

who_is_driving.name: NVDA
who_is_driving.why: Largest drag: 48.5% of the session's dollar-weighted move, -4.3% on 4.9x volume, bottom 4%.

who_is_driving.name: AMD
who_is_driving.why: Largest lift: 17.1% of the session's dollar-weighted move, +5.9% on $19.3B inflow, 89th percentile.

who_is_driving.name: AVGO
who_is_driving.why: 8.0% of the session's dollar-weighted move, +5.5% on $10.1B inflow, 98th percentile.

key_tech.signal: Money rotated from NVDA into AMD and AVGO; net flow +$22.8B but breadth only 25% up.
CEG rose 2.8% on 1.17x volume, but laggard SMR fell 7.8%; breadth 29% up.
Heavy selling: MSTR -6.5%, HOOD -3.8%; basket flow -$2.6B, breadth 0% up.
KWEB fell 3.2% on 2.0x volume, FXI -1.3%; basket flow -$1.3B, breadth 0% up.

stocks.note: Fell 11.3% on 2.4x volume, bottom 1% of its year; $1.9B outflow.
Gold miners dropped 4.0% on 1.3x volume, bottom 9% of its year.
Fell 6.5% on 1.09x volume, bottom 7% of its year; crypto weakness.

risks: 10Y yield at 5.10% after +10.5 bps; TLT -1.5% on 1.3x volume, rates pressuring equities.
Breadth weak: only 18% of names advanced, median stock -0.96%, equal-weight RSP -0.87%.
watch_tomorrow: Whether NVDA stabilizes after 4.9x volume rout or selling continues.
If small caps (IWM) extend losses after bottom-8% session.
